snippet.title: Let's Sing 2027 | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Grab the mic and turn your living room into a stage with Let’s Sing 2027!
Sing your favorite hits solo or with friends and family, and enjoy original music videos, customizable vocal guides, and easy smartphone and mic support.
This year, step into the all-new Party Mode or enjoy the game with enhanced visuals, fresh avatars, and customizable rewards.

Available November 3rd!
